title: Convex Hull
description: Write a Zig program that computes the convex hull of a set of 2D points using the gift wrapping algorithm.
hints: The gift wrapping (Jarvis march) algorithm finds the convex hull by wrapping a line around the points
Start with the leftmost point, then find the point with the smallest polar angle
Use cross product to determine orientation: (B-A) × (C-A)
The cross product sign tells if C is left (positive) or right (negative) of AB
